messages:
elena: Heads-up: design spike this AM about left nav regroup. Idea: surface 'Workspaces' + a compact 'Resources' group under it, but keep quick-global actions (Create, Search) pinned to top. Need feedback on deep-linking and breadcrumb contract.

chris: Love pinning Search. For crumbs I'm thinking: Team > Workspace > Section > Page. Keeps names human-friendly. Show human titles not IDs.

sam: Quick UX note: when groups collapse, users lose context. Maybe show a subtle subheader that persists (e.g., current workspace name) so crumbs still make sense.

jia: Route sketch (client-side + server fallback):
```
/teams/:teamId/ws/:workspaceId/sections/:sectionId/pages/:pageId?view=:view
/p/:shortId  -> resolves to canonical route server-side then client-side replaceState
```
Shortlinks map to canonical route with 301-like resolve endpoint. Client should do replaceState after resolving so history isn't noisy.

mike: Accessibility checklist: skip-to-main anchor, visible focus ring on nav items, aria-current="page" on active link, and announce breadcrumb updates with aria-live="polite" when route changes. Also ensure touch target >=44px.

elena: Agree on aria-live for dynamic crumbs. Also want tab-only changes (view params) to not re-run nav open/close animations. Use history.replaceState for view-only query updates.

chris: Copy suggestion: label group 'Resources' instead of splitting into many top-levels. Within resources use clear verbs: 'Models', 'Endpoints', 'Datasets'. Avoid 'Registry' in top nav.

jia: Implementation note: we'll support shallow routes for query changes and keep a canonical param block for permalinkable state: `?view=versions&panel=compare&focus=line`. Server resolves /p/:shortId by returning 200 with the full canonical path (JSON), client then router.replace().

elena: Can we support deep-scroll anchors for panel-level links? e.g., `/.../pages/123#metrics` should open and focus the metrics panel. Need to coordinate focus management.

mike: Yes but focus must be programmatic and not rely on tab order. Use element.focus({preventScroll:false}) after ensuring aria-hidden toggles are applied. Add e2e for keyboard nav to cover this.

aria-bot: a11y-scan: detected low-contrast on collapsed nav text in dark mode (token-warning). Filing ticket A11Y-497. Also missing skip link on the preview page.

elena: Action items: jia publish full route table + shortlink resolver docs; mike add keyboard test plan and aria-live crumbs; chris finalize resource labels and update copy; sam flow test collapsed-state context. We'll do a dev canary for the new nav next week.

sam: One more: analytics event schema so we can track deep-link opens vs in-app nav. `nav.open`, `nav.deep_link.resolve`, `breadcrumb.click` etc.

jia: Noted. I'll include event spec in the route doc. Target PR early next week.

chris: small visual nit: consider slight divider between Workspaces and Resources to reduce cognitive grouping errors.

elena: Good call. thanks all — will sync in 1:1 with Mike on a11y details.
